text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios is still in shock. To 
brighten her up, her ride-or-die escorts 
her through the party: taking purikura, 
drinking black tea—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race! Running alongside her runaway 
BFF... She threw the ultimate bash with 
her best friend. And right there, Daitaku 
Helios realizes something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then wouldn't throwing a huge party do the 
trick?! If she partied it up in the race, 
Daiichi Ruby and K.S. Miracle would surely 
perk up too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the venue for that party was—the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we can win when long distance is 
totally impossible, that's a legit 
miracle. We'll both be super hyped, no 
doubt. And so, they made the Arima Kinen 
their next goal.
